_what:
row_profiles.py — the member-selection stage's profile OFF the centre row and PAST its
last station. A DIAGNOSTIC (measurement only): nothing here builds, gates or changes a
product; the stage (run_member_crop.sh / member_profile.py) is untouched and its default
behaviour unchanged. Record: row_profiles.json beside this file; scratch (Siril lists,
.ssf) under datasets/corpus/qa_work/row_profiles_work/ (gitignored).

Knob d — ROW-RESOLVED PROFILE: the member's own cached station x-boxes (centre + along
+-600/1200/1800/2400, r 400, clamps included) moved to the TOP row (box y 0..800) and the
BOTTOM row (box y H-800..H); the rule (bar / half-width from datasets/corpus/recipe.json)
applied per row exactly as on the centre row. Centre-row values are READ FROM THE CACHE
(datasets/corpus/member_selection/profiles.json), never re-profiled.
Knob c — OUTER STATION: centre row, dx +2700 with r 200 (+ the -2700 mirror) on the
uncropped members; a box that does not fit is REFUSED and named, never clamped.
Variant c' — the same zone EDGE-ANCHORED (entry box x W-416..W-16, exit mirror 16..416,
r 200) on every uncropped member, a separate block.

Every pixel op and every star is Siril's (load, crop, findstar via star_stations.measure);
the top-30 arithmetic is member_profile.py's own (imported). In-house here: box placement
and bookkeeping. Removal condition: a tool reporting a headless row-resolved star-shape
map (the star_stations.py row of the register) retires this with it.
instrument: Siril findstar via star_stations.measure (gate 'setfindstar reset -roundness=0.05 -sigma=0.5 -relax=on'; load + crop + findstar -out per station); top-30-by-amplitude median of (FWHMx+FWHMy)/2 and of min/max roundness = member_profile.py profile()'s arithmetic (read_rows/apply_rule imported); centre-row values from the tracked cache, not re-profiled

addendum_control_aperture.why: knob c changed TWO things at once — position (+2700 vs +2400) AND aperture (r 200 vs r 400, forced by the geometry: a 400-px box at +2700 falls outside). The 7 members whose +2700 asymmetry crosses 0.20 while +2400 did not could be the last 100 px OR the smaller box's top-30 reaching fainter stars. This control separates them: the +-2400 stations re-measured at r 200 (box cx+2200..cx+2600 and its mirror) on all 50 uncropped members, same gate, same top-30 arithmetic.
addendum_control_aperture.registered_after: the primary outcomes were read (post-hoc CONTROL, not a new knob on any product) — stated so the reader can weigh it
addendum_control_aperture.prediction: if the aperture alone explains the rise: asym(2400,r200) - asym(2400,r400) shows the same +0.10..+0.17 on the 7 finding members; if POSITION explains it: |asym(2400,r200) - asym(2400,r400)| <= 0.05 on >= 40/50 and the finding members' +2700 excess stands over their own r-200 +2400 reading

knob_d_rows.P1_bottom_minus_centre_asym2400_gt_0p10: FAILED 1/5 (pred >= 4/5): bottom-centre at +2400 = +0.006 / +0.023 / +0.015 / +0.071 / +0.102 (aug14/set-04 sub_01, sub_04; aug14/set-05 sub_01, sub_02; aug09/set-05 sub_02) — the far station's asymmetry is the SAME on the bottom row
knob_d_rows.P2_bottom_onset_one_station_inward: HELD 5/5 (pred >= 3/5), stronger than predicted: every cropped member's bottom row crosses the bar at 1200 (centre row 1800 x4, 2400 x1) because the bottom row's asymmetry at 1200 reads +0.284 / +0.352 / +0.289 / +0.290 / +0.202 against +0.093 / +0.037 / +0.020 / +0.128 / +0.042 on the centre row — the entry-side degradation STARTS ~600 px further in on the bottom row and does not get larger at the far station; x_c would be 900 on all five (vs 1500 x4 / 2100 x1)
knob_d_rows.P3_top_within_0p05: FAILED 3/5 (pred >= 4/5): top-centre at +2400 = -0.116 / -0.007 / -0.152 / -0.002 / -0.011 — two members' top rows read a SMALLER far-station asymmetry
knob_d_rows.P4_controls_within_0p05_both_rows: FAILED by the letter on the TOP row for both controls (july31/set-01/sub_01 top -0.072, bottom -0.010; aug06/set-01/sub_01 top -0.070, bottom +0.028): the direction is LESS asymmetric, no control crosses the bar on any row (every onset None) — no crop risk
knob_d_rows.on_the_bar_member_FINDING: aug09/set-05/sub_01 (centre row asym(2400) = 0.200, uncropped by the stage) crosses on BOTH rows — top: onset 2400, x_c 2100 (asym +0.242); bottom: onset 1800, x_c 1500 (asym 1800 +0.335, 2400 +0.302). A min-over-rows rule would crop it at 1500
unpredicted_reported_not_scored: the TOP row's CENTRE station is much softer than the centre row's on the aug14 / aug09-set-05 members — 3.030 / 2.947 / 2.973 / 3.067 vs 2.535 / 2.538 / 2.580 / 2.600 and 2.802 / 2.798 vs 2.415 / 2.435 — and only mildly on the controls (2.480 vs 2.435; 2.473 vs 2.288); that top-row softness is SYMMETRIC (aug14/set-04/sub_01 top row entry 600..2400 = 3.073 / 3.422 / 3.450 / 2.908 against exit 3.152 / 3.330 / 3.045 / 2.632), worst at |dx| 1200-1800 and RECOVERING toward both ends — a band the asymmetry rule is blind to by design (the uniformly-soft case the rule was chosen not to cut)

the centre row's +2400 station is the most ELONGATED (top-30 roundness 0.659-0.677 on the aug14 members) while the top and bottom rows' +2400 boxes are rounder (0.788-0.844) without being sharper — the elongation is a centre-row phenomenon, the softness a row one

bottom-row centre stations sit +0.03..+0.06 above the centre row's (2.595 / 2.585 / 2.620 / 2.630 / 2.495 vs 2.535 / 2.538 / 2.580 / 2.600 / 2.435); the controls' bottom rows are AT or below their centre rows (2.363 vs 2.435; 2.312 vs 2.288)
knob_d_rows.consequence_for_the_rule: a row-resolved x_c = min over rows would crop 600 px more on the five cropped members (x_c 900) and crop the on-the-bar member (1500); the bottom row reaches the bar EARLIER, not HIGHER. Whether that improves the union's corner is a follow-up compose arm (one knob) — and which member row feeds which corpus corner is NOT asserted here (orientation needs the pinned frames first)

knob_c_outer_station.P6_hidden_onset_findings: 7 apparent crossings at the directed geometry (july31/set-03 sub_02..05, aug09/set-03 sub_02 and sub_05, aug09/set-04 sub_03); 4 survive the same-aperture control (july31/set-03 sub_02 +0.173 -> +0.278, sub_03 +0.190 -> +0.247, sub_05 +0.170 -> +0.293; aug09/set-03/sub_02 +0.011 -> +0.223) — BUT NONE IS A FINDING: the control measured the r-200 instrument's own scatter against the r-400 reading at the SAME station as |delta| <= 0.05 on only 38/50, range -0.120..+0.128, and 7 members cross 0.20 at +2400 merely by changing the box from r 400 to r 200 (july31/set-03/sub_04, july31/set-04/sub_01, aug09/set-03/sub_05, aug09/set-04/sub_03, aug09/set-05/sub_01, aug14/set-01/sub_02, aug14/set-01/sub_05). A per-member bar decision cannot be read from an r-200 box
knob_c_outer_station.systematic_answer: same-aperture delta(+2700 - +2400, both r 200): median +0.008 px (min -0.082, max +0.212) on 30 members — NO systematic excess in the last ~100 px of the entry side; NULL on a systematic hidden onset
knob_c_outer_station.verdict: NULL on a systematic hidden onset; per-member crossings UNRESOLVABLE at r 200 (the instrument's scatter, ~+-0.12 px, is half the bar). The blind spot stays a stated limit, now BOUNDED: whatever hides in the last 86-116 px moves the median r-200 asymmetry by +0.008 px over the +2400 station. A 400-px box cannot be placed there by construction, so the bound is what this geometry can give

verdict: KNOB d: P1 FAILED 1/5, P2 HELD 5/5 (the bottom row crosses the bar one station EARLIER on every cropped member, and the on-the-bar member crosses on both rows — a FINDING for a row-resolved rule), P3 FAILED 3/5, P4 FAILED by the letter (top rows -0.072 / -0.070, LESS asymmetric; no control crosses). KNOB c and c': NULL on a systematic hidden onset (same-aperture median +0.008 / +0.027 px); per-member crossings unresolvable at r 200 (control scatter +-0.12 px). Next knob (not run): a row-resolved x_c = min over rows in one compose arm, after the member<->canvas row orientation is pinned.
